skills.trigger: When evaluating a chest X-ray for signs of pneumomediastinum, particularly in patients with neck swelling or chest pain.
steps: Inspect the superior mediastinum and lower neck regions for abnormal radiolucent (dark) streaks within the soft tissues.
Specifically look for air outlining the lateral margins of the trachea (paratracheal region), which appears as vertical lucencies adjacent to the air column of the trachea.

Distinguish this finding from normal anatomical structures by confirming the lucency represents extraluminal gas tracking along fascial planes rather than the tracheal lumen itself or vascular calcifications.
